claims.value: 12 endogenous porcine wound-fluid peptidomics acquisitions mapped to pig, wound and infection group.
claims.evidence: The deposited design maps samples A-L to pig, wound, day and blinded infection group; each maps one-to-one to a deposited Sample_X.zip acquisition container.

limitations: The experiment measures endogenous peptides and has no enzymatic digestion; the reconciler's unsupported-cleavage finding is a false positive for the explicit not-applicable cleavage value.
Pig sex and developmental stage are unavailable.
